title: AST explains the claim to experience, not a feeling

statements.text: AST is a theory of how an information processor arrives at the claim that it has a nonphysical subjective awareness and holds it with certainty. It does not say how a brain could have a nonphysical essence, and it explains how a machine claims an experience and cannot tell the difference.

sources.quote: The theory does not address how the brain might actually possess a non-physical essence.
the theory emphatically does not explain how we have a subjective experience
